node.title: Re: Path Traversal Vulnerability
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Yes, the code isn't safe - see my node [id://1180578].

In the first case, I recommend using [doc://File::Find] or [mod://File::Find::Rule] instead of shelling out to find. In the second case, since you're apparently piping things to the command and from the command, I would suggest [mod://IPC::Run3] (assuming the input and output are not too big, as the module usually works via temporary files) - but it would also be worth looking into whether uda_consolidate.pl could be designed as a module callable directly from your script.
